description: Access token contents and lifetime: subject, capability claims, expiry, tamper rejection.

cases.inputs: user: Nguyễn Thư Ký (thuky@trustcabinet.local); capabilities: [MeetingCreator, MinutesEditor].
cases.note: UC-01 · BR-08 · Deviation: real token carries the full name under claim type "http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/name" (ClaimTypes.Name), not "name"; sub, jti, email, cap x2, no role claim, iss/aud "TrustCabinet", HS256, exp ~15 min, no nbf — all as expected.
preconditions: Signing key configured (at least 32 characters); issuer and audience "TrustCabinet"; access token lifetime 15 minutes.
Active account "Nguyễn Thư Ký" <thuky@trustcabinet.local> with a known id.
cases.return: Signed HS256 JWT with claims sub = user id, jti (unique), email = "thuky@trustcabinet.local", claim "http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/name" = "Nguyễn Thư Ký", and one "cap" claim per capability: MeetingCreator and MinutesEditor; no role claim; issuer and audience "TrustCabinet".

preconditions: Signing key configured (at least 32 characters); issuer and audience "TrustCabinet"; access token lifetime 15 minutes.
cases.return: Signed JWT with sub, jti, email and name claims and no "cap" claim.

cases.inputs: Same user and capabilities; method called twice.
preconditions: Signing key configured (at least 32 characters); issuer and audience "TrustCabinet"; access token lifetime 15 minutes.
cases.return: Two signed JWTs whose jti values differ.
Signed JWT whose exp is about 5 minutes after creation (within a few seconds); it carries no nbf claim.

preconditions: Signing key configured with AccessTokenMinutes = 1 (the smallest allowed).
cases.return: Signed JWT whose exp is about 1 minute after creation.

cases.inputs: Token created for the Secretary, then validated with a different signing key, and again after one character of the payload is changed.
preconditions: Signing key configured (at least 32 characters); issuer and audience "TrustCabinet"; access token lifetime 15 minutes.
cases.return: The token validates under the configured signing key and fails validation under any other key or after tampering.

preconditions: Signing key configured (at least 32 characters); issuer and audience "TrustCabinet"; access token lifetime 15 minutes.
cases.return: Signed JWT whose raw text and claims do not contain the password hash.
